title: Covered-Work Step Added to the Allowance Rate
content:
# Workshop and Protection Desk Liaison Note: The Covered-Work Step on the Allowance Rate

Where the piece on a work order of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service carries coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, a step is added to the allowance rate on that order. It is read from how the coverage stands and the benefit still available on it, set against the bench total the customer is answering for.

1. Where coverage on the piece stands in force and the benefit still available on it is at or above the bench total the customer is answering for, the wide covered-work step of 9 percent is added to the allowance rate.
2. Where coverage stands in force and the benefit still available on it falls below that total, the narrow covered-work step of 4 percent is added.
3. In any other case no step is added on this ground.

## Both sides of the comparison

| How the coverage stands | Benefit still available against the bench total answered for | Step added |
|---|---|---|
| in force | at or above the total | 9 percent |
| in force | equal to the total | 9 percent, the comparison being at or above |
| in force | below the total | 4 percent |
| not in force | whatever it shows | no step on this ground |

## A hypothetical reading

On a work order where the bench total the customer is answering for stands at 1,000.00 USD: coverage in force with 1,000.00 USD of benefit still available carries 9 percent, the benefit being at that total; coverage in force with 1,400.00 USD still available carries 9 percent; coverage in force with 600.00 USD still available carries 4 percent; and where the coverage has been cancelled, no step is added on this ground.
